question: Why does literariness fail to shine when it is reduced merely to qualities like good nourishment?
premises: It does not shine when gone merely to qualities.
It is compared to good nourishment.
inference: True literariness exceeds a mere accumulation of pleasing qualities.
uncertainties: The force of abhisauhitya+vat as a simile is interpretive.
plain_english: Indeed, literariness does not shine when it is reduced merely to qualities, as if it were just good nourishment.
